decisive_items: Serum complement-fixation IgG antibody titers of 1:512
Left lower lobe nodular consolidation and lymphadenopathy
response.rationale: High serum and CSF complement-fixation titers with leptomeningeal involvement and prior travel through Mexico strongly suggest neurocysticercosis; CSF low glucose is atypical but can occur. Tuberculous meningitis is plausible but negative mycobacterial PCR and lack of stated exposure lower specificity.

rejected.why: Negative mycobacterial PCR and no definitive TB exposure; CSF findings not fully typical.
No syphilis-specific testing, negative HIV, and insufficient features.
